story.zh: 刘琮秘不发丧，将荆州拱手献给曹操，曹操命虎豹骑星夜疾驰围堵新野的刘备...
story.en: Liu Cong concealed his father's death and surrendered Jing Province to Cao Cao. Cao Cao then ordered the Tiger Cavalry to ride through the night to encircle Liu Bei at Xinye...

trigger.zh: 曹操、刘关张、赵云、诸葛亮、甘梅、糜贞存活。襄阳属曹操，新野、江夏属刘备。
trigger.en: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Gan Mei, and Mi Zhen are alive. Xiangyang belongs to Cao Cao, Xinye and Jiangxia belong to Liu Bei.

forbidden.zh: 主角是甘梅、糜贞时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot be triggered if the protagonist is Gan Mei or Mi Zhen.

defy.zh: 【<刘备势力><与糜贞关系等级达到3级>使糜贞存活并使其成为恋人并加入家族】
defy.en: 【<Liu Bei Faction><Relationship level with Mi Zhen reaches Level 3> Ensure Mi Zhen survives, make her your Beloved, and have her join your Family】
